backflip_assessment.credit_scope: simulator assisted showcase acceptance only; passing does not establish PPO improvement, an unassisted learned backflip, or distinguish a null control
backflip_assessment.measurement_scope: 50 Hz per-episode samples for a clearly assisted launch, unassisted learned-policy landing window, explicit handoff, and final stable stand

recipe_options.assist_measurement: assist_torque_norm is the legacy generalized-force zero-detection channel; use assist_force_n and assist_torque_nm for physical units
recipe_options.handoff: pretrained alpha_stand after braked upright foot contact

segments.normalizationLabel: BC/DAgger initializer; no PPO reward scale

initializer.label: exact alpha_stand actor and normalizer transfer; no BC optimizer
